description: I built AstroData to detect exoplanets and model multi-planet systems using NASA TESS data. The pipeline stitches raw light curves with lightkurve, it then finds orbital periods via BLS periodograms, and uses REBOUND N-body simulations to measure Transit Timing Variations and estimate planet masses. It then exports the orbital parameters into a custom Blender script to generate 3D system renders. I am working solo on the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge.
